data: Tesla delivered a strong fiscal 2022, with revenue rising 51.4% to $81.5 billion from $53.8 billion in fiscal 2021. Profitability expanded even faster, as net income climbed 127.5% to $12.6 billion in fiscal 2022 from $5.5 billion in fiscal 2021, pointing to meaningful operating leverage on the larger revenue base. Cash generation kept pace, with operating cash flow increasing to $14.7 billion in fiscal 2022 from $11.5 billion in fiscal 2021. The balance sheet grew as well: total assets reached $82.3 billion at fiscal 2022 versus $62.1 billion at fiscal 2021, while total liabilities rose more modestly to $36.4 billion from $30.5 billion. Cash and cash equivalents eased to $16.3 billion in fiscal 2022 from $17.6 billion in fiscal 2021, a decline we view as manageable given the company's robust operating cash flow.
